doc.title: Larry Gold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2025

title: Sammy Davis Jr. and the Latin Casino gigs
summary: Gold's long hair and the Latin Casino job as a teenager with Philadelphia musicians such as Don Renaldo.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Yeah. So apparently Sammy Davis Jr. tried to fire you for having long hair?

Longer hair than him. He had straight hair and it was down to like right here. Yeah that was one of my gigs at the Latin Casino that Curtis really didn't enjoy, that I loved. And plus in those days I would go smoke a reefer and come in smelling of pot and everybody knew that I did and nobody said a word because I could play the music blindfolded. I mean they loved the fact that here was this 15, 16—year—old kid who was in the union and could play better than them and grew up in Philadelphia and they were all Philadelphia musicians. Most of them were Italian. A lot of them were jazz musicians. I mean Don Renaldo, the great contractor for the Philly Sound was like Joe Venuti. He played jazz violin more than he played legitimate violin.
